rationale: Keep Governance ontology concept types separate from concrete invariant and rule instances while registering CAV2-D64 without claiming adoption or enforcement.
migration_impact: Profile v1 consumers must either remain on the historical package or add the invariant_registry and rule_registry fields and validate both new closed registries under profile v2. Existing concept-type and relation registries retain their identities and shapes.
rollback: Remove the invariant and rule registries and this witness, remove their profile and material-inventory entries, restore the profile and schema identifiers to v1, remove the D64 source selectors and residue entry, and restore the prior documentation and validator expectations.
claim_ceiling: Records an additive candidate ontology schema epoch only; it does not adopt D64 into a Constitution, validate a Project binding, extend the Rust kernel, or activate enforcement.
